target_customer: Managed service providers and internal IT departments that need to document passwords, assets, networks and processes
problem: IT teams kept credentials, network documentation and procedures scattered across tools, and existing MSP documentation products were seen as costly and SaaS only.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription with cloud and self-hosted options

founders.name: Jacob Hart
founders.background_notes: YC page gives no background; a Hudu blog snippet says he launched Hudu in 2018 while YC and the About page say 2019.

founders.name: John Hart
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him; no bio.

competitors.name: IT Glue
competitors.what: documentation platform for MSPs, owned by Kaseya
competitors.funding_then: acquired by Kaseya in December 2018 per a later review site

technical_complexity.rationale: A documentation and password vault product with integrations to PSA and RMM tools is standard SaaS engineering; security of stored credentials adds care but not research difficulty.

defensibility.rationale: Documentation stores are sticky once filled and integrated, but IT Glue, Passportal and open source options such as ITFlow offered substitutes.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents kept selling their products; review sites later call Hudu the closest alternative to IT Glue, so Hudu took share on price and hosting flexibility. The IT Glue acquisition date comes from a 2024 review page.

market_need_then: Reviews describe MSPs frustrated by pricing, user minimums and SaaS only lock-in of the incumbent, which Hudu avoids; this comes from later comparison pages, not from 2021 sources.

branding.domain_note: Uses hudu.com; acquisition history not found. Older URLs show usehudu.com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Positions itself as the most-loved IT documentation platform; YC bio shows a light tone.

branding.brand_signature: Most-loved IT documentation platform claim, backed by 4.7 of 5 across 350+ G2 reviews per its site
branding.community_and_virality: Runs a community forum at community.hudu.com; no wider virality found.

brand_strength.rationale: Niche MSP brand with a customer community and review scores, but no independent press about the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Hudu is active and claims more than 6,000 IT teams, with a team of 26 on the YC page. After YC in Winter 2021 it announced a reported 5 million dollar Series A led by Arthur Ventures in May 2023. Growth appears to come from price and hosting flexibility against IT Glue; a second major version, Hudu 2, was released at an unknown date. Other funding is not found.
notes: Series A of 5 million in May 2023 led by Arthur Ventures appears in CB Insights and VCBacked search summaries (aggregators); the Hudu About page fetch did not show it. CB Insights lists a seed dated 2021-01 and total raised 5.13 million, VCBacked says 5.0 million total; Seedtable labels the round Growth; one aggregator shows a 2026 date, likely an error. Founders' backgrounds not found. Competitor IT Glue is listed with the Kaseya acquisition event date because no source dated near the batch was found; the source itself is from 2024. Hudu's site names Passportal, Confluence and SharePoint as comparison pages, not dated. Founded year conflict: 2018 (blog) vs 2019 (YC).
